request: 升级时自动更新完整性基线，确认是正常升级后再更新，避免下次升级又报degraded
acceptance: Only a root-managed image build digest matching the running binary and a changed version/commit can prepare a transition.
Do not update before application initialization and first successful health response; recheck identity and data integrity before committing.
Back up prior baseline and atomically replace it; keep existing data unchanged.
Unverified/same-identity binary changes, failed readiness and corrupted data retain baseline and alert.
Cover upgrade, rollback, tampering, backup failure and data preservation with isolated tests.

requirements.summary: User requests automatic safe upgrade baseline refresh; no production restart or release in this implementation turn.
evidence: Existing RC1 baseline persisted after RC8 image upgrade.

design.summary: Root-managed image checksum outside persistent data; changed build identity and clean data required; prepare at startup, recheck and commit only at first ready health request. One-shot candidate, backup before atomic replacement, serialized periodic checks.

implementation.summary: Implemented Linux packaged-image transition with unchanged initial-install behavior; rejects unknown/same identity, missing/unsafe checksum, changed candidate or data errors. No general baseline-reset API or environment override.

verification.summary: Docker Go race integrity tests, focused go vet, quick checks and real isolated two-build upgrade/failed-start/tamper/rollback lifecycle passed. Existing fixture project/settings/token unchanged. Live9999 remains integrity=ok with the same instanceId; no live mounts in lifecycle test.

documentation.summary: Documented trust boundary, readiness timing, previous-baseline recovery, legacy image and unpackaged runtime limitations.

cleanup.summary: Reviewed owned source/test/docs additions; temporary lifecycle containers and images removed by fixture cleanup. Existing services/data preserved; diff check passes.

release.summary: Explicit authorization for RC9 deployment, push and release; full gate, backup and live acceptance required.

release_authorization: 用户：那你把这个修复部署到9999，验收正常后把主程序push和release，别影响现有数据。
rollback: Before accepting a verified ready build, a content-addressed copy of the prior baseline is retained in .integrity/baseline-before-<digest>.json. On verified older-image rollback, the same readiness validation restores its identity. No project/session/settings migration is introduced.
handoff: RC9 release in progress. Preserve9999 mounts, settings, sessions, workspace and ProfessionalProject0.4.14; backup before deployment.
